about: Nutivili world recipe library. Amounts from official food records; method written for the app.

recipes.name: Egusi soup
steps: Season the beef with half the salt and simmer in the stock until tender, about 30 minutes. Keep the stock.
Blend the tomatoes, chilli and half the onion. Grind the melon seeds and mix them with the rest of the onion and a splash of water into a paste.
Heat the palm oil, add the egusi paste and fry, stirring, for 5 minutes until it starts to curdle.
Add the blended tomato mix, the beef with its stock and the dried shrimp. Simmer 15 minutes, stirring now and then.
Stir in the spinach, add the remaining salt to taste and cook 3 more minutes.

recipes.name: Jollof rice
steps: Blend the tomatoes, red pepper, half the onion and the chilli until smooth.
Heat the oil, fry the rest of the onion for 2 minutes, then add the tomato paste and fry 3 minutes.
Add the blended mix and cook until thick and the oil rises, about 20 minutes.
Add the stock and salt, then stir in the rice (weights are for cooked rice; use about 400 g raw rice and extra stock if starting from raw).
Cover tightly and cook on low until the rice is soft and has absorbed the sauce, stirring once.

recipes.name: Moi moi
steps: Soak the beans, rub off the skins and rinse.
Blend the beans with the red pepper, onion and a little water to a smooth, thick batter.
Stir in the oil, the ground dried shrimp and salt to taste.
Pour into greased bowls, wraps or tins, adding sliced boiled egg to each.
Steam, covered, for about 45 minutes until set and firm.

recipes.name: Akara
steps: Soak and peel the beans, then blend with the onion and chilli and very little water to a thick paste.
Whisk the paste hard for 2–3 minutes to add air. Add salt to taste.
Heat the oil in a deep pan. Drop in spoonfuls of batter.
Fry, turning, until golden brown on all sides, about 4 minutes. Drain on paper.

recipes.name: Suya
steps: Slice the beef thinly against the grain.
Grind the peanuts finely and mix with the chilli and salt to make the yaji spice.
Coat the beef with oil, then with most of the spice mix. Thread onto skewers.
Grill over high heat 4–5 minutes a side, sprinkling more spice as it cooks.
Serve with sliced raw onion.

recipes.name: Pounded yam
steps: Peel the yam, cut into chunks and boil until very soft, about 20 minutes.
Drain and pound in a mortar (or a food processor), adding a splash of the cooking water.
Keep pounding until smooth and stretchy with no lumps. Shape into balls and serve warm.

recipes.name: Eba
steps: Bring the water to the boil.
Take off the heat and sprinkle in the garri while stirring.
Leave 1 minute, then stir firmly with a wooden spoon until smooth and thick. Serve warm.

recipes.name: Efo riro
steps: Simmer the seasoned beef until tender.
Blend the red peppers, chilli and half the onion coarsely.
Heat the palm oil, fry the rest of the onion, then add the pepper mix and fry 15 minutes until thick.
Add the beef and dried shrimp and simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in the chopped spinach and salt, cook 3 minutes and serve.

recipes.name: Okra soup
steps: Simmer the beef in the stock until tender.
Add the palm oil, onion, chilli and dried shrimp and cook 5 minutes.
Add the chopped or grated okra and cook 5–7 minutes, stirring, until it draws.
Season with salt and serve.

recipes.name: Goat pepper soup
steps: Cut the goat meat into pieces and rinse.
Put in a pot with the stock, onion, chilli and salt.
Simmer covered for about an hour until the meat is tender.
Taste, adjust the salt and serve hot.

recipes.name: Puff puff
steps: Mix the flour and sugar, then add the warm water and beat into a soft, sticky batter.
Cover and leave in a warm place until doubled, about an hour (add yeast if you use it).
Heat the oil in a deep pan.
Drop in small balls of batter and fry, turning, until golden all over. Drain on paper.

recipes.name: Chin chin
steps: Mix the flour and sugar, then rub in the butter until crumbly.
Add the beaten egg and milk and knead into a firm dough.
Roll out thin and cut into small cubes.
Fry in hot oil in batches until golden and crunchy. Drain and cool.

recipes.name: Waakye
steps: Soak the beans for a few hours, then boil until almost tender (traditionally with dried sorghum leaves for the colour).
Add the rice and enough water to cover.
Cook covered on low until the rice and beans are soft and the water is absorbed.

recipes.name: Rice and peas
steps: Put the kidney beans, coconut milk, onion, thyme and salt in a pot with a little water and bring to a simmer.
Add the rice (weights are for cooked rice; use about 320 g raw with enough water to cover).
Cover and cook on low until the rice is tender and the liquid absorbed, about 20 minutes. Fluff and serve.

recipes.name: Ackee and saltfish
steps: Soak the saltfish in water (or boil twice) to remove salt, then flake it.
Fry the onion and pepper in the oil for 3 minutes, then add the tomato.
Add the saltfish and cook 3 minutes.
Gently fold in the drained ackee and warm through without breaking it up. Season and serve.

recipes.name: Curry goat
steps: Season the goat with the curry powder, garlic, onion and salt; leave an hour or overnight.
Heat the oil, add a little more curry powder and brown the meat well.
Add the stock, cover and simmer about 1½ hours until tender.
Add the potatoes and cook 20 more minutes until soft and the sauce has thickened.
ingredients: Curry powder (or the dish’s spice mix)

recipes.name: Jerk chicken
steps: Blend the onion, chilli, oil and salt (plus your jerk spices) into a paste.
Rub all over the chicken and marinate at least 2 hours.
Grill or roast at 200 °C for 35–45 minutes, turning, until charred and cooked through.

recipes.name: Ugali
steps: Bring the water to the boil.
Add the maize meal gradually, stirring all the time.
Keep stirring and pressing against the side of the pot for 8–10 minutes until stiff and smooth.
Turn out, shape and serve.

recipes.name: Sukuma wiki
steps: Fry the onion in the oil until soft.
Add the tomatoes and cook down 3 minutes.
Add the shredded collards and salt, stir and cook 5 minutes until just tender.

recipes.name: Fish and chips
steps: Cut the potatoes into chips and fry or oven-bake until golden.
Make a batter with the flour and water.
Dip the cod in the batter and deep-fry in hot oil for 6–7 minutes until crisp.
Drain and serve with the chips.

recipes.name: Full English breakfast
steps: Grill or fry the sausages and bacon until cooked.
Fry the mushrooms and halved tomatoes.
Heat the baked beans.
Fry or poach the eggs and toast and butter the bread. Serve together.

recipes.name: Beans on toast
steps: Heat the baked beans in a pan.
Toast the bread and butter it.
Pour the beans over the toast.

recipes.name: Chicken shawarma wrap
steps: Season the chicken with shawarma spices and grill or pan-fry until cooked, then slice.
Warm the pita.
Fill with the chicken, sliced onion and tomato, and a spoon of yogurt. Roll up.

recipes.name: Lamb kofta kebab
steps: Grate the onion and squeeze out the juice.
Mix with the lamb and salt (plus cumin or mixed spice) and knead well.
Shape around skewers and grill 8–10 minutes, turning, until cooked through.

recipes.name: Shakshuka
steps: Fry the onion and sliced peppers in the oil until soft.
Add the chopped tomatoes and salt and simmer 10 minutes into a thick sauce.
Make wells and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook on low until the whites are set, 6–8 minutes.

recipes.name: Chicken tikka masala
steps: Marinate the chicken in the yogurt, half the garlic and ginger, half the curry powder and salt for at least 30 minutes.
Grill or pan-fry the chicken until charred.
In the oil, fry the onion until golden, then the rest of the garlic, ginger and curry powder.
Add the tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes, then add the chicken and simmer 10 more.
ingredients: Curry powder (or the dish’s spice mix)

recipes.name: Dal
steps: Rinse the lentils and simmer in water until soft, about 25 minutes.
Fry the onion, garlic and curry powder in the oil until golden.
Add the tomatoes and cook 5 minutes.
Stir into the lentils with the salt and simmer 5 minutes.
ingredients: Curry powder (or the dish’s spice mix)

recipes.name: Nasi goreng
steps: Fry the onion and chilli in the oil for 2 minutes.
Add the diced chicken and cook through.
Add the cooked, cold rice and the soy sauce and stir-fry 5 minutes.
Fry the eggs and serve on top.

recipes.name: Beef tacos
steps: Brown the beef with the onion, adding taco seasoning.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with the beef, chopped tomato and grated cheese.

recipes.name: Poutine
steps: Fry or bake the chips until crisp.
Heat the gravy.
Put the hot chips in a dish, scatter the cheese over and pour on the hot gravy.

recipes.name: Butter tart
steps: Line a tart tin or small tins with the pastry.
Melt the butter and mix with the brown sugar, syrup and eggs.
Scatter the raisins in the cases and pour the filling over.
Bake at 190 °C for 15–20 minutes until set and bubbling.
ingredients: Pie crust, standard-type, prepared from recipe (cooked weight)

recipes.name: Ayran
steps: Whisk the yogurt with the cold water and salt until frothy.
Serve chilled.

recipes.name: Lahmacun
steps: Mix the flour, water, oil and salt into a soft dough and rest 30 minutes.
Finely chop the onion, tomato, chilli and parsley and mix with the lamb.
Roll the dough very thin and spread the meat mix right to the edges.
Bake at 250 °C for 6–8 minutes until the edges crisp.

recipes.name: Kebab koobideh
steps: Grate the onion and squeeze out the juice.
Knead with the lamb, beef and salt until sticky.
Press onto flat skewers and grill over high heat 3–4 minutes a side.

recipes.name: Ghormeh sabzi
steps: Finely chop the parsley, spinach, leek and coriander and fry in half the oil until dark and fragrant, about 15 minutes.
Brown the onion and lamb in the rest of the oil.
Add the water, cover and simmer 1 hour.
Add the herbs, kidney beans, lime and salt and simmer 45 minutes more.

recipes.name: Tahdig
steps: Parboil the rice (weights are for cooked rice), drain.
Mix a few spoons of rice with the yogurt.
Heat the butter and oil in a non-stick pot, spread the yogurt rice on the bottom, then pile in the rest.
Cover with a cloth-wrapped lid and cook on low 40–50 minutes until the base is golden and crisp. Turn out.

recipes.name: Mandi
steps: Season the chicken with mandi spices and salt.
Fry the onion in the butter and oil, add water and the chicken and simmer 30 minutes.
Remove the chicken and roast until golden.
Cook the rice in the stock until tender and serve with the chicken on top.

recipes.name: Molokhia
steps: Bring the stock to a simmer.
Add the finely chopped jute leaves and cook 5 minutes without boiling hard.
Fry the garlic in the oil until golden and stir into the soup with the salt.

recipes.name: Coxinha
steps: Poach the chicken in the stock, shred it, and mix with fried onion and the cream cheese.
Bring the stock and butter to the boil, add the flour all at once and stir into a smooth dough. Cool.
Wrap dough around spoonfuls of filling and shape into drops.
Dip in beaten egg (and crumbs) and deep-fry until golden.

recipes.name: Goi cuon
steps: Cook the prawns and pork and slice thinly.
Dip a rice paper sheet in warm water for a few seconds.
Lay on lettuce, noodles, carrot, mint, pork and prawns and roll up tightly.
Serve with a dipping sauce.

recipes.name: Nigerian stew
steps: Blend the tomatoes, peppers, chilli and half the onion. Boil down to remove water, about 15 minutes.
Fry the rest of the onion in the oil, then the tomato paste for 3 minutes.
Add the blended mix and salt and fry 25–30 minutes, stirring, until the oil floats on top.

recipes.name: Ofada stew
steps: Boil and blend the green and red peppers and chilli, then boil until dry.
Bleach the palm oil carefully in a covered pot on low heat until clear (ventilate well), then cool slightly.
Fry the onion in the oil, add the pepper mix and fry 20 minutes.
Add the cooked beef and offal and salt and simmer 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Yam porridge
steps: Peel and cube the yam and boil with water to just cover.
Blend the tomatoes, pepper and onion and add with the palm oil, dried shrimp and salt.
Simmer until the yam is soft, mashing a few pieces to thicken.
Stir in the spinach for the last 3 minutes.

recipes.name: Beans porridge
steps: Boil the beans until soft (weights are for cooked beans).
Add the blended tomato, pepper and onion, palm oil, dried shrimp and salt.
Simmer 15 minutes, mashing some beans to thicken.

recipes.name: Ewa agoyin
steps: Boil the beans until very soft and mash lightly with salt.
Blend the dried chilli with the onion.
Heat the palm oil until very hot, fry the onion and chilli mix on low for 20 minutes until dark.
Serve the sauce spooned over the beans.

recipes.name: Gizdodo
steps: Boil the gizzards with salt until tender, then fry until browned.
Fry the plantain cubes until golden.
Fry the onion, then the blended tomato and pepper, in the oil for 15 minutes.
Toss in the gizzards and plantain and cook 3 minutes.

recipes.name: Asun
steps: Season the goat meat with salt and grill or roast until cooked and smoky.
Chop into small pieces.
Fry the onion and chilli in the oil, add the meat and toss for 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Edikang ikong
steps: Simmer the beef and fish until tender, with very little water.
Add the palm oil, onion, chilli and dried shrimp and cook 5 minutes.
Add the chopped kale (in place of waterleaf), cook 5 minutes, then the spinach (in place of ugu) and salt.
Cook 3 more minutes; the soup should be thick.

recipes.name: Banku
steps: Mix the maize meal and grated cassava dough with water into a smooth slurry (traditionally left to ferment 1–2 days).
Cook on medium heat, stirring hard all the time, for 15–20 minutes until thick and stretchy.
Shape into balls with a wet bowl.

recipes.name: Kelewele
steps: Cut ripe plantain into cubes.
Toss with grated ginger, chilli and salt and leave 10 minutes.
Fry until deep golden. Drain and serve.

recipes.name: Red red
steps: Cook the beans until soft (weights are for cooked beans).
Fry the onion and chilli in the palm oil, add the tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in the beans and salt and cook 10 minutes.
Serve with fried plantain.

recipes.name: Shito
steps: Blend the onion, garlic and ginger.
Heat the oil, add the blend and fry on low for 20 minutes.
Add the ground dried shrimp and chilli and keep frying, stirring often, for 40–60 minutes until very dark.
Cool and store in a clean jar.

recipes.name: Groundnut soup
steps: Season the chicken and simmer with the onion and a little stock for 15 minutes.
Whisk the peanut butter with some hot stock until smooth.
Add the blended tomatoes, chilli, peanut mixture and the rest of the stock.
Simmer 40 minutes, stirring, until the oil rises. Add salt to taste.

recipes.name: Light soup
steps: Season the chicken with ginger, onion and salt and steam it in its own juices 10 minutes.
Boil the tomatoes, onion and chilli, then blend.
Add the stock and the blend to the chicken, strain if you like it smooth.
Simmer 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Kontomire stew
steps: Fry the onion in the palm oil, add the blended tomato and cook 10 minutes.
Add the flaked fish and the chopped cocoyam leaves.
Cook 10 minutes, then stir in the beaten egg and cook until set.

recipes.name: Thieboudienne
steps: Fry the seasoned fish in the oil, then remove.
Fry the onion and tomato paste in the same oil, add water and the carrots, cabbage and aubergine and simmer until tender.
Return the fish for 10 minutes, then lift out the fish and vegetables.
Cook the rice in the sauce until tender (weights are for cooked rice). Serve topped with fish and vegetables.

recipes.name: Mafe
steps: Brown the beef in the oil with the onion.
Add the tomato paste, then the stock, and simmer 40 minutes.
Whisk in the peanut butter, add the sweet potato and carrots and salt.
Simmer 30 minutes until the vegetables are soft and the sauce thick.

recipes.name: Chakalaka
steps: Fry the onion and peppers in the oil, add the curry powder and chilli.
Add the grated carrot and tomatoes and cook 10 minutes.
Stir in the baked beans and heat through.
ingredients: Curry powder (or the dish’s spice mix)

recipes.name: Bobotie
steps: Soak the bread in half the milk.
Fry the onion and curry powder in the oil, add the beef and brown.
Mix in the squeezed bread and sugar and spread in a dish.
Beat the eggs with the rest of the milk, pour over and bake at 180 °C for 35 minutes until set.
ingredients: Curry powder (or the dish’s spice mix)

recipes.name: Bunny chow
steps: Fry the onion and curry powder, add the beef and brown.
Add the tomatoes and water and simmer 40 minutes, then add the potatoes and cook until soft.
Hollow out the bread loaf and fill with the curry, using the inside bread as a lid.
ingredients: Curry powder (or the dish’s spice mix)

recipes.name: Pilau
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and garlic in the oil, add pilau spice and salt.
Add water and simmer until the beef is almost tender.
Add the rice and enough water to cook it, cover and cook on low until the rice is tender (weights are for cooked rice).
ingredients: Curry powder (or the dish’s spice mix)

recipes.name: Matoke
steps: Peel and slice the green bananas (matoke).
Fry the onion in the oil, add the tomatoes and the beef and cook 10 minutes.
Add the bananas and water to cover with salt.
Simmer 20 minutes until soft; mash slightly if you like.

recipes.name: Githeri
steps: Fry the onion in the oil, add the tomatoes and cook 5 minutes.
Add the boiled maize and beans and salt with a little water.
Simmer 10 minutes.

recipes.name: Irio
steps: Boil the potatoes and peas until soft; add the maize and spinach for the last 5 minutes.
Drain and mash everything with the butter and salt until green and fairly smooth.

recipes.name: Doro wat
steps: Cook the finely chopped onions in a dry pot on low for 20 minutes until deep brown, then add the butter.
Stir in the paprika (berbere), chilli and tomato paste and cook 5 minutes.
Add the chicken and a cup of water and simmer 40 minutes.
Add the peeled hard-boiled eggs and simmer 10 minutes more.

recipes.name: Shiro
steps: Fry the onion and garlic in the oil, add the tomatoes and cook 5 minutes.
Add the water and bring to a simmer.
Whisk in the chickpea flour gradually and cook on low 15 minutes, stirring, until smooth and thick. Add salt.

recipes.name: Tibs
steps: Cut the beef into cubes.
Sear in the butter on high heat for 3 minutes.
Add the onion, pepper, garlic and chilli and stir-fry 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Kitfo
steps: Warm the spiced butter until just melted.
Mix with the finely minced lean beef and chilli (mitmita).
Serve raw or lightly warmed (leb leb). Raw meat carries a food-safety risk.

recipes.name: Chicken tagine
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil, then the onion.
Add the tomatoes, carrots and tagine spices with a little water.
Cover and simmer 45 minutes.
Add the chickpeas, dates and salt and cook 15 minutes more.

recipes.name: Harira
steps: Brown the diced lamb and onion in the oil.
Add the lentils, chickpeas, tomatoes and stock and simmer 1 hour.
Add the pasta and cook until tender.
Stir in the parsley and salt.

recipes.name: Koshari
steps: Cook the lentils, rice and pasta separately (weights are cooked).
Fry the sliced onion in the oil until crisp and brown.
Make a sauce from the tomatoes, vinegar and salt, simmered 15 minutes.
Layer rice, lentils, pasta and chickpeas, top with sauce and crispy onions.

recipes.name: Ful medames
steps: Warm the cooked fava beans with a little water.
Mash lightly with the garlic, lemon juice and salt.
Drizzle with olive oil to serve.

recipes.name: Baba ganoush
steps: Grill or roast the aubergines until the skin chars and the flesh collapses.
Scoop out the flesh and drain.
Mash with the tahini, lemon juice and garlic. Drizzle with olive oil.

recipes.name: Fattoush
steps: Toast or fry the pita until crisp and break into pieces.
Chop the lettuce, tomatoes, cucumber, onion and parsley.
Dress with the oil, lemon juice and salt and toss with the pita just before serving.

recipes.name: Mansaf
steps: Simmer the lamb in water until tender, about 1½ hours.
Warm the yogurt (jameed) gently, stirring so it doesn’t split, and add some lamb stock.
Cook the lamb in the yogurt sauce 15 minutes.
Serve on the rice, brushed with melted butter.

recipes.name: Kabsa
steps: Fry the onion in the oil, add the chicken and brown.
Add the tomatoes, carrots, kabsa spices and salt with water and simmer 40 minutes.
Remove the chicken and roast until golden.
Cook the rice in the broth until tender and serve with the chicken.
ingredients: Curry powder (or the dish’s spice mix)

recipes.name: Souvlaki
steps: Marinate the pork in the oil, lemon and oregano.
Thread onto skewers and grill until cooked.
Grate the cucumber into the yogurt to make tzatziki.
Serve in warm pita with tomato, onion and tzatziki.

recipes.name: Chana masala
steps: Fry the onion in the oil until golden, then the garlic, ginger and curry powder.
Add the tomatoes and cook down 10 minutes.
Add the chickpeas, salt and a little water and simmer 15 minutes.
ingredients: Curry powder (or the dish’s spice mix)

recipes.name: Rajma
steps: Fry the onion until golden, then the garlic, ginger and curry powder.
Add the tomatoes and cook 10 minutes.
Add the kidney beans, salt and water and simmer 20 minutes until thick.
ingredients: Curry powder (or the dish’s spice mix)

recipes.name: Chicken karahi
steps: Heat the oil and brown the chicken.
Add the garlic, ginger and chopped tomatoes and cook covered 10 minutes.
Uncover and cook on high, stirring, until the sauce is thick and the oil separates.
Add the green chilli and salt.

recipes.name: Haleem
steps: Soak and cook the lentils and bulgur (weights are cooked).
Brown the onion, garlic, ginger and spices in the oil, add the beef and water and cook until falling apart.
Mix in the lentils and grains and cook on low, mashing and stirring, for an hour until smooth.
ingredients: Curry powder (or the dish’s spice mix)

recipes.name: Nihari
steps: Brown the beef in the oil with the onion, garlic, ginger and spices.
Add the stock and simmer on very low heat 3 hours.
Mix the flour with water and stir in to thicken; cook 20 minutes.
ingredients: Curry powder (or the dish’s spice mix)

recipes.name: Vegetable pulao
steps: Fry the onion in the oil until golden.
Add the peas, rice, salt and water (weights are for cooked rice).
Cover and cook on low until the rice is tender.

recipes.name: Momo
steps: Mix the flour and water into a dough and rest 20 minutes.
Mix the beef with the finely chopped cabbage, onion, garlic, ginger and soy sauce.
Roll small circles of dough, fill and pleat closed.
Steam 12–15 minutes.

recipes.name: Mapo tofu
steps: Fry the pork in the oil until browned, add the garlic and chilli bean paste.
Add the stock and soy sauce and bring to a simmer.
Add the cubed tofu and simmer 5 minutes, thickening with a little starch if you like.

recipes.name: Peking duck
steps: Dry the duck skin, then roast until crisp and the meat is cooked.
Slice thinly.
Serve in warm pancakes with cucumber and hoisin sauce.
ingredients: Duck, domesticated, meat and skin (cooked weight)

recipes.name: Char siu
steps: Mix the honey, soy sauce and brown sugar (plus five-spice) into a marinade.
Marinate the pork strips at least 2 hours.
Roast at 200 °C for 30–40 minutes, basting with the marinade, until glazed and charred.

recipes.name: Banh mi
steps: Cook and slice the pork.
Split the baguette and warm it.
Fill with the pork, pickled carrot, cucumber and chilli.

recipes.name: Bun cha
steps: Season the pork and shape into small patties; grill until charred.
Mix the fish sauce, sugar, lemon juice and water into a dipping broth with the carrot.
Serve the patties in the broth with rice noodles and lettuce.

recipes.name: Thai red curry
steps: Fry the curry paste in the oil for 1 minute.
Add half the coconut milk and cook until the oil separates.
Add the chicken, then the rest of the coconut milk, the pepper, fish sauce and sugar.
Simmer 10 minutes until the chicken is cooked.
ingredients: Curry powder (or the dish’s spice mix)

recipes.name: Massaman curry
steps: Fry the curry paste in some of the coconut milk.
Add the beef and the rest of the coconut milk and simmer 1 hour.
Add the potatoes, onion, peanuts, fish sauce and sugar and simmer 30 minutes until tender.
ingredients: Curry powder (or the dish’s spice mix)

recipes.name: Tom yum
steps: Bring the stock to a boil with the bruised lemongrass and chilli.
Add the mushrooms and tomatoes and simmer 3 minutes.
Add the prawns and cook 2 minutes.
Season with fish sauce and lime juice off the heat.

recipes.name: Som tam
steps: Shred the green papaya.
Pound the chilli, then add the fish sauce, lime juice and sugar.
Add the papaya and tomatoes and bruise lightly. Top with peanuts.

recipes.name: Larb
steps: Cook the pork in a dry pan with a splash of water, breaking it up.
Off the heat, add the fish sauce, lime juice, chilli and sliced onion (and toasted rice powder).
Serve with lettuce leaves.

recipes.name: Beef rendang
steps: Blend the onion, chilli, garlic, ginger and lemongrass into a paste.
Fry the paste, add the beef and coconut milk.
Simmer uncovered on low for 2½–3 hours, stirring, until the sauce is almost dry and dark.
Season with sugar and salt.

recipes.name: Nasi lemak
steps: Cook the rice in the coconut milk (weights are for cooked rice).
Fry the chilli and onion in the oil into a sambal, adding the dried shrimp.
Fry the peanuts and boil the eggs.
Serve the rice with sambal, egg, peanuts and cucumber.

recipes.name: Laksa
steps: Fry the curry paste and chilli in the oil.
Add the stock and coconut milk and simmer 10 minutes.
Add the prawns and tofu and cook 3 minutes.
Pour over the noodles and bean sprouts.
ingredients: Curry powder (or the dish’s spice mix)

recipes.name: Sinigang
steps: Simmer the pork in the stock with the onion and tomatoes until tender.
Add the souring agent (tamarind) and the lime juice.
Add the okra and cook 5 minutes, then the greens.
Season with fish sauce.

recipes.name: Pancit
steps: Fry the onion in the oil, add the sliced chicken and cook.
Add the carrots and cabbage and soy sauce with a little water.
Toss in the noodles and cook until the liquid is absorbed.

recipes.name: Chicken katsu
steps: Flatten the chicken and season with salt.
Coat in flour, then egg (then breadcrumbs).
Fry in the oil 4–5 minutes a side until golden and cooked through. Slice.

recipes.name: Oyakodon
steps: Simmer the onion in a little water, soy sauce and sugar for 3 minutes.
Add the sliced chicken and cook through.
Pour over the beaten eggs, cover and cook until just set.
Slide onto the rice.

recipes.name: Onigiri
steps: Wet your hands and salt them.
Shape the warm rice around a little tuna into a triangle.
Wrap with a strip of nori.

recipes.name: Miso soup
steps: Heat the water (or dashi) with the seaweed.
Add the cubed tofu.
Take off the boil and whisk in the miso. Top with spring onion.

recipes.name: Gyoza
steps: Mix the pork with the finely chopped cabbage, garlic, ginger and soy sauce.
Fill the wrappers (made from the flour and water) and pleat closed.
Fry in the oil until the bases brown, add a splash of water, cover and steam 3 minutes.

recipes.name: Okonomiyaki
steps: Mix the flour, eggs and water into a batter, then fold in the shredded cabbage.
Pour into a hot oiled pan, top with the bacon.
Cook 5 minutes a side until golden.
Top with okonomiyaki sauce and mayonnaise.

recipes.name: Bulgogi
steps: Slice the beef very thinly.
Marinate in the soy sauce, sugar, garlic, onion and oil for 30 minutes.
Stir-fry or grill on high heat 3–4 minutes.

recipes.name: Japchae
steps: Cook the noodles and toss with a little oil and soy sauce.
Stir-fry the beef, then the onion, carrots and spinach separately.
Toss everything with the rest of the soy sauce and sugar.

recipes.name: Kimbap
steps: Season the rice with oil and salt.
Make a thin omelette and cut into strips; cook the carrot and spinach.
Spread rice on the seaweed, line up the fillings and ham and roll tightly.
Slice into rounds.

recipes.name: Doubles
steps: Mix the flour with water and a little curry powder into a soft dough and rest an hour.
Cook the chickpeas with the onion, curry powder and water until soft and saucy.
Flatten small pieces of dough and fry until puffed (bara).
Sandwich the chickpeas between two baras.
ingredients: Curry powder (or the dish’s spice mix)

recipes.name: Jamaican festival
steps: Mix the cornmeal, flour and sugar, add the milk and knead into a soft dough.
Shape into small logs.
Fry in the oil until golden.

recipes.name: Bammy
steps: Grate the cassava and squeeze out all the liquid.
Press into rounds in a hot pan and cook until set.
Soak in coconut milk, then fry in the oil until golden.

recipes.name: Escovitch fish
steps: Season the fish and fry in the oil until crisp.
Simmer the vinegar with the onion, carrot, pepper and chilli for 3 minutes.
Pour the hot pickle over the fish and leave to soak.

recipes.name: Pelau
steps: Caramelise the brown sugar in the oil until dark, then add the seasoned chicken and brown.
Add the onion, carrots, pigeon peas and coconut milk.
Add the rice and water, cover and cook until tender (weights are for cooked rice).

recipes.name: Griot
steps: Marinate the pork in the lime juice, onion and seasoning.
Simmer in a little water until tender.
Drain and fry in the oil until crisp and brown.

recipes.name: Mofongo
steps: Fry the green plantain pieces until golden.
Fry the bacon until crisp.
Mash the plantain with the garlic, olive oil, bacon and salt in a mortar. Shape into domes.

recipes.name: Feijoada
steps: Soak the black beans overnight and simmer until tender.
Brown the pork, sausage and bacon.
Fry the onion and garlic, add to the beans with the meats and salt.
Simmer 1½ hours until thick.

recipes.name: Pão de queijo
steps: Bring the milk and oil to the boil and pour over the tapioca flour; mix well.
When warm, beat in the eggs, then the cheese.
Roll into balls and bake at 190 °C for 20–25 minutes until puffed.

recipes.name: Moqueca
steps: Marinate the fish in the lime juice and salt.
Layer the onion, tomato and pepper in a pot, then the fish.
Pour over the coconut milk and palm oil.
Simmer covered 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Lomo saltado
steps: Stir-fry the beef strips in the oil on high heat.
Add the onion and tomato wedges and cook 2 minutes.
Add the soy sauce and vinegar.
Toss with the chips and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chimichurri
steps: Finely chop the parsley and garlic.
Mix with the oil, vinegar, chilli and salt.
Leave 20 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Spanish omelette
steps: Slice the potatoes and onion thinly and cook slowly in the oil until soft, about 20 minutes. Drain.
Beat the eggs with the salt and mix in the potatoes.
Cook in a pan on low until almost set, flip with a plate and cook 2 more minutes.

recipes.name: Patatas bravas
steps: Roast the potato cubes until crisp.
Fry the garlic and chilli in the oil, add the tomatoes and simmer into a sauce.
Pour the sauce over the potatoes.

recipes.name: Cottage pie
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and carrots, add the gravy and simmer 20 minutes.
Boil the potatoes and mash with the butter and milk.
Put the meat in a dish, top with mash and bake at 200 °C for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Sunday roast
steps: Roast the beef to your liking and rest it.
Roast the potatoes until crisp; boil the carrots and peas.
Bake the Yorkshire puddings and heat the gravy.
Slice the beef and serve everything together.

recipes.name: Bangers and mash
steps: Grill or fry the sausages.
Boil the potatoes and mash with the butter and milk.
Heat the gravy and peas and serve together.

recipes.name: Jacket potato with beans and cheese
steps: Bake the potato at 200 °C for about an hour until crisp outside and soft inside.
Heat the beans.
Split the potato, add the butter, beans and grated cheese.

recipes.name: Ploughman’s lunch
steps: Arrange the bread, cheese, ham, apple, lettuce and tomato on a plate.
Serve with butter and pickle.

recipes.name: Eton mess
steps: Whip the cream to soft peaks.
Crush the meringues and chop the strawberries.
Fold together just before serving.

recipes.name: Sticky toffee pudding
steps: Soak the chopped dates in boiling water.
Cream half the butter with half the sugar, beat in the eggs, then fold in the flour and dates.
Bake at 180 °C for 30 minutes.
Melt the rest of the butter and sugar with the cream into a sauce and pour over.

recipes.name: Mac and cheese
steps: Melt the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the milk until thick.
Stir in most of the cheese.
Mix with the cooked pasta, top with the rest of the cheese and grill until golden.

recipes.name: BBQ ribs
steps: Season the ribs and bake covered at 150 °C for 2½ hours.
Brush with barbecue sauce.
Grill or roast uncovered until sticky and charred.

recipes.name: Smoothie bowl
steps: Blend the frozen banana and strawberries with the yogurt until thick.
Pour into a bowl.
Top with granola and honey.

recipes.name: Galbi
steps: Marinate the short ribs in the soy sauce, brown sugar, onion, garlic and oil for at least 1 hour.
Grill on high heat until charred, 3–4 minutes a side.

recipes.name: Udon noodles
steps: Mix the flour, water and salt into a stiff dough and knead well; rest 30 minutes.
Roll out thick and cut into strips.
Boil 10–12 minutes until chewy and serve in broth.

recipes.name: Jollof rice, Ghanaian style
steps: Fry the onion in the oil, then the tomato paste.
Add the blended tomatoes, pepper and chilli and cook until thick.
Add the stock, salt, carrots and peas.
Add the rice, cover and cook on low until tender (weights are for cooked rice).

recipes.name: Fried rice, Nigerian style
steps: Parboil the rice with curry powder, thyme and stock (weights are for cooked rice).
Fry the diced liver in a little oil.
Stir-fry the carrots, peas, sweetcorn, pepper and onion in the oil.
Add the rice in batches and stir-fry until hot. Add salt.
ingredients: Curry powder (or the dish’s spice mix)

recipes.name: Native jollof (palm oil rice)
steps: Heat the palm oil and fry the onion and chilli.
Add the stock, dried shrimp and salt.
Add the rice and cook covered until tender (weights are for cooked rice).
Stir in the greens for the last 3 minutes.

recipes.name: Nyama choma (grilled goat)
steps: Season the goat meat with salt.
Grill slowly over charcoal, turning, until cooked and smoky.
Squeeze over lemon and chop to serve.

recipes.name: Pondu (cassava leaf stew)
steps: Pound or blend the cassava leaves and boil for an hour until tender.
Add the palm oil, onion, garlic, pepper, dried shrimp and salt.
Simmer 30 minutes more.

recipes.name: Kottu roti
steps: Shred the roti.
Stir-fry the onion, carrots and cabbage in the oil with curry powder.
Add the cooked chicken and the eggs and scramble.
Add the roti and chop and toss on the griddle until mixed.
ingredients: Curry powder (or the dish’s spice mix)

recipes.name: Gallo pinto
steps: Fry the onion and pepper in the oil.
Add the cooked black beans with some of their liquid.
Stir in the cooked rice and salt and fry until mixed and dry.

recipes.name: Bandeja paisa
steps: Cook the beans until soft; fry the pork belly until crisp.
Fry the seasoned beef mince.
Fry the plantain and an egg; make a small arepa from the cornmeal.
Serve everything on a plate with the rice and sliced avocado.

recipes.name: Acarajé
steps: Soak and peel the beans, then blend with the onion and salt into a thick paste.
Whisk until light.
Fry spoonfuls in the hot palm oil until deep golden.
Split and fill with the dried shrimp.

recipes.name: Pelmeni
steps: Mix the flour, egg, water and salt into a firm dough and rest 30 minutes.
Mix the beef, pork, grated onion and salt.
Roll thin, cut circles, fill and seal into little rings.
Boil 6–8 minutes until they float and are cooked.

recipes.name: Dolma (stuffed vine leaves)
steps: Rinse the vine leaves.
Mix the rice with the chopped onion, tomato, parsley, half the oil and salt.
Roll a spoon of filling in each leaf and pack tightly in a pot.
Add the rest of the oil, the lemon juice and water to cover and simmer covered 45–60 minutes.

recipes.name: Amala
steps: Bring the water to the boil.
Sprinkle in the yam flour (elubo) while stirring hard.
Keep turning on low heat for 3–5 minutes until smooth and stretchy.

recipes.name: Amala lafun
steps: Bring the water to the boil.
Add the cassava flour (lafun) gradually, stirring hard.
Cover for 2 minutes, then turn until smooth.

recipes.name: Fufu
steps: Put the fermented cassava paste in a pot with a little water.
Cook on medium heat, stirring hard, for 15–20 minutes until it turns slightly translucent and stretchy.
Shape into balls.

recipes.name: Semovita
steps: Bring the water to the boil.
Sprinkle in the semolina while stirring.
Cover for 2 minutes, then stir firmly until smooth.

recipes.name: Wheat swallow
steps: Bring the water to the boil.
Add the wheat meal gradually, stirring all the time.
Cover and cook 3–4 minutes, then turn until smooth.

recipes.name: Tuwo shinkafa
steps: Cook soft rice in extra water until very soft.
Mash with a wooden spoon on low heat until smooth and sticky.
Shape into balls.

recipes.name: Tuwo masara
steps: Make a thin pap with some of the water and maize flour.
Add the rest of the flour gradually, stirring hard, until stiff.
Cover and cook 5 minutes, then turn and shape.

recipes.name: Tuwo dawa
steps: Make a thin pap with some of the water and sorghum flour.
Add the rest of the flour gradually, stirring hard, until stiff.
Cover and cook 5 minutes, then shape.

recipes.name: Starch (Urhobo)
steps: Mix the cassava starch with the palm oil and a little water.
Cook on low heat, stirring all the time, until it turns clear, thick and stretchy.
Shape and serve with banga soup.

recipes.name: Oat swallow
steps: Blend the oats into flour.
Bring the water to the boil and add the oat flour gradually, stirring.
Cook 3–4 minutes, turning until smooth.

recipes.name: Plantain swallow
steps: Blend dried unripe plantain into flour.
Add to the boiling water gradually, stirring hard.
Cook 3–4 minutes, turning until smooth.

recipes.name: Cocoyam fufu
steps: Boil the peeled cocoyam until very soft.
Pound until smooth and stretchy.
Shape into balls.

recipes.name: Poundo yam
steps: Bring the water to the boil.
Add the poundo yam flour gradually, stirring hard.
Cover for 2 minutes, then turn until smooth.

recipes.name: Ogbono soup
steps: Simmer the beef and fish in the stock until tender.
Melt the palm oil and stir in the ground ogbono until dissolved.
Add to the stock with the chilli, onion and dried shrimp and stir until it draws.
Simmer 10 minutes, add the greens and salt.

recipes.name: Banga soup
steps: Boil the palm fruits, pound and squeeze out the juice with the water; strain.
Simmer the juice with the beef, stock, onion and chilli for 30 minutes until it thickens.
Add the catfish and dried shrimp and cook 10 minutes. Add salt.

recipes.name: Afang soup
steps: Simmer the beef and fish in the stock until tender.
Add the palm oil, onion, chilli and dried shrimp.
Add the waterleaf and cook 5 minutes.
Add the ground afang leaves (or the amaranth listed) and salt and cook 5 more minutes.

recipes.name: Oha soup
steps: Boil and pound the cocoyam into a paste.
Simmer the beef and fish in the stock, add the palm oil, chilli, dried shrimp and ogiri.
Add the cocoyam paste in lumps and cook until dissolved and thick.
Add the oha leaves (or amaranth) and salt and cook 3 minutes.

recipes.name: Bitterleaf soup
steps: Boil and pound the cocoyam into a paste.
Simmer the beef and fish in the stock, add the palm oil, chilli and dried shrimp.
Add the cocoyam paste and cook until thick.
Add the washed bitterleaf and salt and simmer 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Ofe nsala
steps: Boil and pound the yam into a paste.
Bring the stock to a boil with the onion, chilli and dried shrimp.
Add the catfish and cook 10 minutes.
Add the yam paste in lumps and simmer until thick. Add salt.

recipes.name: Ewedu soup
steps: Boil the water, add the picked jute leaves and cook 5 minutes.
Whisk or blend until smooth.
Add the locust beans, dried shrimp and salt and simmer 3 minutes.

recipes.name: Gbegiri
steps: Soak and peel the beans, then boil until very soft.
Mash or blend until smooth.
Add the palm oil, stock, chilli, locust beans and dried shrimp and simmer 15 minutes. Add salt.

recipes.name: Miyan kuka
steps: Simmer the beef in the stock with the onion and chilli.
Add the oil, locust beans and dried shrimp.
Whisk in the baobab leaf powder gradually so it doesn’t lump.
Simmer 5 minutes and add salt.

recipes.name: Miyan taushe
steps: Simmer the beef in the stock with the onion and chilli.
Add the pumpkin cubes and cook until soft; mash some.
Stir in the groundnut paste and palm oil and simmer 10 minutes.
Add the greens and salt and cook 3 minutes.

recipes.name: Ofe owerri
steps: Boil and pound the cocoyam into a paste.
Simmer the beef, fish and snails in the stock with the palm oil and dried shrimp.
Add the cocoyam paste and cook until thick.
Add the pumpkin leaves and waterleaf and salt and cook 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Fisherman soup
steps: Bring the stock to a simmer with the palm oil, onion and chilli.
Add the catfish and snails and cook 10 minutes.
Add the prawns and cook 3 minutes.
Add the pumpkin leaves and salt.

recipes.name: Atama soup
steps: Extract the palm fruit juice with the water and simmer until slightly thick.
Add the beef, fish, stock, dried shrimp and chilli and cook 20 minutes.
Add the waterleaf and atama leaves and salt and cook 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Nigerian fried rice
steps: Parboil the rice with curry powder, thyme and stock (weights are for cooked rice).
Fry the diced liver.
Stir-fry the carrots, peas, peppers and onion in the oil.
Add the rice in batches and stir-fry until hot. Add salt.
ingredients: Curry powder (or the dish’s spice mix)

recipes.name: Abacha (African salad)
steps: Soak the dried abacha in cold water until soft, then drain.
Mix the palm oil with potash water until it turns yellow and creamy.
Stir in the ugba, dried shrimp, chilli, sliced onion and salt.
Add the abacha and mix well.

recipes.name: Masa
steps: Soak the rice overnight, then blend with a little cooked rice and water into a batter; leave to rise a few hours (yeast helps).
Stir in the sugar.
Fry spoonfuls in an oiled masa pan, turning once, until golden.

recipes.name: Boli (roasted plantain)
steps: Peel ripe plantains.
Roast over charcoal or under a grill, turning, until charred in spots and soft inside.

recipes.name: Zobo drink
steps: Boil dried hibiscus leaves in the water with the ginger and pineapple for 20 minutes.
Leave to cool, then strain.
Stir in the sugar and chill.

recipes.name: Kunu
steps: Soak the millet with the ginger overnight, then blend with some of the water and strain.
Boil part of the liquid until it thickens, then stir it into the rest.
Sweeten with the sugar and chill.

recipes.name: Chapman
steps: Mix the two soft drinks with the water and sugar over ice.
Add the lemon juice and cucumber slices (and a dash of grenadine and bitters).

recipes.name: Fura da nono
steps: Crumble the millet balls (fura).
Mix with the cold fermented milk (nono) and water.
Sweeten with sugar.

recipes.name: Kuli kuli
steps: Knead the groundnut paste to squeeze out the oil, adding the chilli and salt.
Shape into small rings or sticks.
Fry in the oil until hard and golden.

recipes.name: Agidi
steps: Mix the fermented maize paste with water and cook, stirring, until very thick.
Wrap in leaves or pour into moulds and leave to set.

recipes.name: Coconut rice
steps: Fry the onion and pepper in the oil, add the dried shrimp.
Add the coconut milk, water and salt and bring to a boil.
Add the rice, cover and cook on low until tender (weights are for cooked rice).

recipes.name: Fried yam
steps: Peel the yam and cut into chips.
Rinse, salt and fry until golden outside and soft inside.

recipes.name: Peppered snail
steps: Clean the snails well and boil until tender.
Fry the blended peppers, chilli and onion in the oil for 10 minutes.
Add the snails and salt and toss for 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Isi ewu
steps: Boil the goat meat (traditionally the head) with salt until tender, then cut into pieces.
Mix the palm oil with potash water until thick and yellow.
Stir in the ground ugba, chilli and onion.
Toss the meat in the sauce and serve warm.

recipes.name: Nkwobi
steps: Boil the cow foot until tender.
Mix the palm oil with potash water until thick and yellow.
Add the ground ugba, chilli, onion and salt.
Toss in the meat and warm through.

recipes.name: Dambu nama
steps: Boil the beef with salt and spices until tender, then shred finely.
Fry in a little oil, stirring, until dry and crisp.

recipes.name: Okpa
steps: Mix the Bambara nut flour with the warm water, palm oil, chilli and salt into a smooth batter.
Pour into leaves or greased tins.
Steam for about an hour until firm.

recipes.name: Fish roll
steps: Rub the butter into the flour and sugar, add water and knead into a dough.
Cook the flaked mackerel with the onion, chilli and salt.
Roll out the dough, add a line of fish, roll up and seal.
Fry in the oil until golden (or bake at 190 °C for 25 minutes).
